about:
Herb Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1952 in Lebanon, Pennsylvania, when Frank Herb and his sons Jack and Ray purchased the David High Metal Shop at 317 S. 6th St. for $6,000. The business, originally Frank L. Herb & Sons, later became Herb Hardware, Sheetmetal & Roofing before splitting into three companies in the 1960s, with Herb Sheet Metal emerging as the fabrication arm. The company has remained in the Herb family through four generations; Jack Herb Sr. led the firm until his death in 1996, followed by Jack Herb Jr., who retired in 2023 and passed ownership to his son Steve Herb Sr.

The shop produces custom metal and fiberglass duct board for commercial and residential HVAC systems. Its metalworking capabilities cover bending, rolling, welding, and plasma cutting of materials from 26 gauge to 11 gauge, primarily mild steel and aluminum. Fiberglass duct board is supplied flat or pre‑assembled in three thicknesses. The company also provides on‑site measurement, duct layout design, installation, and duct leakage testing.

Customers include mechanical contractors, builders, and DIY homeowners across central Pennsylvania. Projects range from simple cut‑and‑bend parts to intricate countertops and full ductwork systems for new construction and retrofit jobs.

Herb Sheet Metal emphasizes its multi‑generational family ownership and the continuity of hands‑on expertise, stating that experienced technicians fabricate each piece to the customer’s exact specifications.
